product_overview: STAGE is a collaborative web review platform for auditing live websites through a secure proxy, placing feedback pins on page elements, and managing review issues in one workspace. It also provides a spatial blueprint canvas for planning site architecture and a client-facing review portal for guest collaboration.
core_goals: Review live websites in a secure, interactive workspace
Leave structured feedback pinned to specific page elements
Track and manage review issues across a project
Generate AI-assisted design and architecture suggestions
Plan multi-page site structure on a collaborative spatial canvas
Share review access with clients through a guest review portal

features.name: Interactive Pin & Comment Placement
features.description: Users can inspect a live proxied page, select a page element, and create a feedback pin with categorized review details.
user_flows: Navigate to /project/[id] -> Open a review session -> Click a target element in the staging iframe -> Fill comment title and description -> Select severity and issue type -> Submit the pin -> See the saved pin appear in the feedback drawer

Navigate to /review/[token] -> Open a shared client review session -> Click a target element in the live canvas preview -> Fill comment title and description -> Select severity and issue type -> Submit the pin -> See the saved pin appear in the feedback feed

features.name: STAGE AI Copilot Site Analysis
features.description: Users can run an AI analysis of the reviewed site to get strategic design recommendations and visually inspect suggested improvements.
user_flows: Navigate to /project/[id] -> Open the review workspace -> Trigger AI site analysis from the copilot bar -> View the top 3 design recommendations -> Open a benchmark inspiration link -> Preview the suggested visual change on the canvas -> Save the recommendation as a permanent pin

features.name: Developer Directive & Prompt Export
features.description: Users can open a feedback item and export a developer-ready prompt for implementation in external coding tools.
user_flows: Navigate to /issues -> Open an observation pin detail -> Review the senior developer directive and benchmark reference -> Copy the prompt for Cursor -> See confirmation that the prompt was copied to the clipboard

features.name: Project Dashboard and Workspace Management
features.description: Users can access their workspace dashboard to view projects and review sessions, and create or manage project workspaces from the app.
user_flows: Navigate to /dashboard -> View the list of projects and audit sessions -> Open a project workspace -> Return to the dashboard to continue managing projects
Navigate to /dashboard -> Start creating a new project workspace -> Enter the project name and target URL -> Save the new project -> See the project appear in the workspace list

features.name: Blueprint Spatial Canvas Collaboration
features.description: Users can plan site architecture on an infinite spatial canvas, connect frames, and collaborate in real time with other participants.
user_flows: Navigate to /canvas/[projectId] -> Open the spatial blueprint canvas -> Create a new frame -> Position the frame on the canvas -> Connect frames with a flow arrow -> See the visual site flow update

Navigate to /canvas/[projectId] -> Open the spatial blueprint canvas -> Move the cursor across the canvas -> Observe other collaborators' presence and cursor movement -> Select a frame or target to broadcast the selection

features.name: Unified Audit Issue Tracking
features.description: Users can review all feedback items in one place, filter issues by status, and update issue progress as work moves forward.
user_flows: Navigate to /issues -> View the unified list of audit issues -> Filter issues by status -> Open an issue detail -> Update the issue status to in progress or resolved -> See the issue remain organized in the tracker

features.name: Account and Workspace Settings
features.description: Users can update profile and workspace preferences, including AI provider settings and notification delivery options.
user_flows: Navigate to /settings -> Review account profile and workspace configuration -> Update profile details -> Save the changes -> See the updated account information reflected in settings
Navigate to /settings/ai -> Review available AI provider options -> Select or change the provider configuration -> Save the AI settings -> Return to the settings area with the new provider configured
Navigate to /settings/notifications -> Enter a Slack or Discord webhook URL -> Save notification preferences -> Return to the notification settings with delivery configured

features.name: Public Pricing Information
features.description: Visitors can compare available plans and review feature differences before choosing a plan.
user_flows: Navigate to /pricing -> Review the available pricing tiers -> Compare Free and Team feature breakdowns -> Proceed toward checkout from the pricing page

routes.description: Public landing page showcasing visual review and design copilot features
Project management dashboard listing team projects and audit sessions
Interactive review session workspace, DOM element pinning, and AI Copilot bar
Secure client review portal with pin creation and live canvas preview
Spatial multiplayer Blueprint canvas with real-time collaborative cursors
Unified audit issue tracker, status filters, and developer directives
Pricing tiers, Free vs Team feature breakdown, and checkout trigger
User account profile and workspace configuration
AI provider resolution (OpenRouter, Google Gemini, NVIDIA NIM)
Notification preferences, digest frequency, and Slack/Discord webhook setup

features.name: Interactive Pin & Comment Placement
features.description: Auditors and clients click on any web element to leave categorized feedback pins
user_interactions: Click target element in the staging iframe
Select severity (Low, Medium, High, Critical) and issue type
View saved pin in the feedback drawer

features.name: STAGE AI Copilot Site Analysis
features.description: Senior AI heuristics engine analyzes site DOM fingerprint and generates top 3 architectural suggestions
user_interactions: Click AI Copilot analyze button on bottom docked bar
View top 3 strategic design recommendations (CRO, Typography, Polish)
Inspect benchmark inspiration link (Linear Bento, Stripe Checkout, Vercel Ribbon)
Click Live Preview to see visual CSS mutation on canvas
Click Pin for Developer to save permanent pin

features.name: Developer Directive & Prompt Export
features.description: Generates copyable prompts for Cursor, Claude Code, and Antigravity with architecture specs
user_interactions: View Senior Developer Directive and benchmark link
Click Copy Prompt for Cursor button
See success toast confirming prompt is copied to clipboard

features.name: Webhook & Outbox Notifications
features.description: Dispatches real-time Slack Block Kit, Discord embeds, and outbox notifications upon pin creation
user_interactions: Enter project Slack or Discord webhook URL
Receive instant notification card when client confirms pin
